newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones rose 101.60 points to 6,544.09. PLDT's ADR rose $0 1/2 to 51 7/8.
* On Friday, the peso softened to 26.290 to a U.S. dollar from 26.286.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,169.26, down 14.78.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate fell to 11.21875 pct from 12.8125 pct.
